decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch still promoted in 2024 and tightly aligned with the firm's established coolant-management business, management is likely to justify its investment and keep it on the market.

The centrifuge fits the firm's innovation, sustainability and process-media strategy, and a large engineering firm with visible R&D commitments is likely to persist with it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

The scraper belt chip conveyor remains publicly offered and supports the firm's core conveying and production-support portfolio, so escalation of commitment favors continuation despite some risk of portfolio pruning.
Although conveyor variants can be rationalized, this hinged belt model was still on the website in 2024 and is close to the firm's core offer, making continued support more likely than withdrawal.
